On the fiscal 2026 Q3 earnings call (period ended June 30, 2026), CEO Paul Shoukry stated Raymond James has the largest addressable market in the industry because it has all the affiliation options an adviser could want, and that the firm is agnostic about how an adviser affiliates, wanting advisers drawn by the culture, values, platform and capabilities.

On the fiscal 2026 Q3 earnings call (period ended June 30, 2026), CEO Paul Shoukry stated the firm does not lead with the highest check but with culture and capabilities, has a true differentiated value proposition, and remains disciplined on transition assistance and economics to advisers.

On the earnings call covering the period ended September 30, 2025, CEO Paul Shoukry stated the firm is focused on the long term and providing a stable platform for its advisors, bankers and associates, and that it attracts and retains financial advisors with its unique culture, leading service and robust platform rather than the largest check, valuing independence.

On the earnings call covering the period ended December 31, 2025, CEO Paul Shoukry stated the value proposition is having the largest addressable market across its affiliation options, from employee to independent contractor to RIA custody, with critical mass and decades of experience in all of them.

On the fiscal 2026 Q1 earnings call (period ended March 31, 2026), CEO Paul Shoukry stated advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities, as the firm offers a unique combination of an adviser- and client-focused culture with leading technology, products and solutions, plus a strong balance sheet, long-term thinking and commitment to independence.

On the earnings call covering the period ended December 31, 2025, CEO Paul Shoukry stated recruiting is a marathon, not a sprint, that it cannot be dialed up or down quarter by quarter without losing quality advisors, and that the firm wants advisors who want to be there over the long term rather than those moving for the highest check.
